text:
If you've got outdoor plans today, get after them now, because this pleasant stretch has a shelf life. It's a mild, easy 72 out there at midday with light south wind, and Burlington should hold onto that partly sunny, low-humidity feel right through the afternoon, with the high topping out near 79. The lake's still cooperating this afternoon too, winds under 10 knots before they build into the 15 to 20 knot range later on, so if you're headed to the water, earlier is better.

The change comes tonight. Showers move in after 8pm and look like a good soaking, a quarter to half an inch, with the European model actually running wetter than the official call, so I'd trust the rain over just a passing shower. Wind picks up out of the south too, gusting into the 15 to 25 knot range on the broad lake with waves building to 3 to 5 feet, so plan any evening paddling or boating to wrap up well before dark. Monday carries the unsettled pattern forward with showers and a few thunderstorms likely.

week.blurb: Partly sunny and pleasant near 79, but showers move in after dark, and the Euro says soak it.
Rain and thunderstorms likely most of Monday with a high near 77, and I'd trust the wetter read here.
Tuesday's the pick of the week, mostly sunny, dry, and comfortable with a high near 79.
Wednesday starts dry and warm near 82, then showers and thunderstorms roll in by afternoon.
Thursday's showers clear out early, leaving a mostly sunny, comfortable afternoon near 78.
Friday looks like the gem of the stretch, sunny and dry with a high near 80.
Saturday stays mostly sunny and warm near 82, with just a slight chance of showers late.
